sample_space.description: Evacuable temperature workspace: -73 to 177 C at altitude up to 100,000 ft (8 torr). Single front door with cam action lock; stainless-steel internal pressure liner; one adjustable shelf standard; one standard stainless-steel access port heliarc welded to the liner (sizes 3, 4, 5 or 6 in, user-selected). Product page lists the workspace as 16 ft3 / 453 L; brochure lists 16 ft3 / 478 L.

notes: Thermotron FA-16-CH-5-5 temperature-only altitude chamber, standard configuration (no humidity, no window, no 150,000 ft extension, no positive pressure). Outer box 48 W x 74 D x 91 H in (122 x 188 x 231 cm), approx. shipping weight 4,000 lbs / 1,814 kg (BC-150 brochure, August 2017). Workspace 24 W x 38 D x 32 H in (61 x 97 x 81 cm), 16 ft3; brochure gives 478 L, product page gives 453 L (catalog uses 453 L). Air temperature -73 to 177 C; altitude to 100,000 ft (30.5 km; 8 torr). Two 5 hp compressors per the model-number convention. 8800 Controller with 12 in colour touchscreen standard. Window: brochure lists 'Heat-Tempered, Multi-Pane Window with Bars' as an option and the catalog configuration states it is not fitted, so windows=0; note the product page's generic Features text says 'Almost all Thermotron chambers come with one standard window' (conflict recorded, catalog basis followed). One standard access port (stainless steel, heliarc welded to liner, 3/4/5/6 in sizes) is the only published pass-through; wiring kind 'none' means no fixed looms. Air-cooled condenser is inside the cabinet on standard models (product page). Snapshots: research/v5/cache/f9cde0ad105c5dda.txt (brochure), research/v5/cache/1e60c1ed8a41b879.txt (product page).
